name: US-Japan Rate Differential & USD/JPY: A Carry Trade Correlation Study
description: Comprehensive research analyzing how the US-Japan 10-year interest rate differential has historically driven USD/JPY over 10 years. Uses DGS10 (US 10Y Treasury, daily) and IRLTLT01JPM156N (Japan 10Y JGB, monthly, forward-filled). Computes rate differential (US minus Japan) and analyzes: (1) Summary statistics with full-period Pearson correlation, current/avg/min/max differential and USD/JPY; (2) Dual-axis time series overlay of USD/JPY and rate differential; (3) Rolling 60-day correlation of daily changes; (4) Scatter plot of rate differential vs USD/JPY with regression; (5) Lead/lag cross-correlation at offsets -30 to +30 days; (6) Regime bar chart showing average monthly USD/JPY return by rate differential quartile.
source:
# ============================================================================
# US-Japan Interest Rate Differential & USD/JPY Correlation Study
# ============================================================================
# Analyzes the carry trade relationship between the US-Japan 10Y yield spread
# and USD/JPY over ~10 years of daily data.
#
# Data: USD/JPY (daily), US 10Y Treasury (DGS10, daily FRED),
#       Japan 10Y JGB (IRLTLT01JPM156N, monthly FRED → ffilled to daily)
# ============================================================================

# ============================================================================
# DATA SOURCES
# ============================================================================

# USD/JPY daily close
src = market_data_source()()
close_fx = src.c

# US 10-year Treasury yield (daily)
us_10y_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='DGS10', use_alfred=False)()
us_10y = ffill(us_10y_raw.result)

# Japan 10-year JGB yield (monthly, forward-filled to daily)
jp_10y_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='IRLTLT01JPM156N', use_alfred=False)()
jp_10y = ffill(jp_10y_raw.result)

# Rate differential: US 10Y minus Japan 10Y (in percentage points)
rate_diff = us_10y - jp_10y

# Bar timestamps for time-axis charts
ts = index()

# ============================================================================
# DAILY CHANGES (for correlation of changes)
# ============================================================================

d_rate = rate_diff - (rate_diff >> 1)
d_fx = close_fx - (close_fx >> 1)

# ============================================================================
# ROLLING 60-DAY CORRELATION OF DAILY CHANGES
# ============================================================================

rolling_corr_60d = rolling_corr(window=60, window_type=WindowType.rolling, method=CorrelationMethod.pearson)(x=d_rate, y=d_fx)

# ============================================================================
# FULL-PERIOD EXPANDING CORRELATION (for summary)
# ============================================================================

full_corr = rolling_corr(window=60, window_type=WindowType.expanding, method=CorrelationMethod.pearson)(x=close_fx, y=rate_diff)

# ============================================================================
# LEAD/LAG CROSS-CORRELATION (offsets: -30, -20, -10, -5, 0, 5, 10, 20, 30)
# ============================================================================
# Positive lag = rate_diff leads USD/JPY (today's rate_diff vs future USD/JPY)
# Negative lag = USD/JPY leads rate_diff

# lag -30: rate_diff lags USD/JPY by 30 days
corr_lag_n30 = rolling_corr(window=252, window_type=WindowType.expanding, method=CorrelationMethod.pearson)(x=d_rate >> 30, y=d_fx)
# lag -20
corr_lag_n20 = rolling_corr(window=252, window_type=WindowType.expanding, method=CorrelationMethod.pearson)(x=d_rate >> 20, y=d_fx)
# lag -10
corr_lag_n10 = rolling_corr(window=252, window_type=WindowType.expanding, method=CorrelationMethod.pearson)(x=d_rate >> 10, y=d_fx)
# lag -5
corr_lag_n5 = rolling_corr(window=252, window_type=WindowType.expanding, method=CorrelationMethod.pearson)(x=d_rate >> 5, y=d_fx)
# lag 0
corr_lag_0 = rolling_corr(window=252, window_type=WindowType.expanding, method=CorrelationMethod.pearson)(x=d_rate, y=d_fx)
# lag +5
corr_lag_p5 = rolling_corr(window=252, window_type=WindowType.expanding, method=CorrelationMethod.pearson)(x=d_rate, y=d_fx >> 5)
# lag +10
corr_lag_p10 = rolling_corr(window=252, window_type=WindowType.expanding, method=CorrelationMethod.pearson)(x=d_rate, y=d_fx >> 10)
# lag +20
corr_lag_p20 = rolling_corr(window=252, window_type=WindowType.expanding, method=CorrelationMethod.pearson)(x=d_rate, y=d_fx >> 20)
# lag +30
corr_lag_p30 = rolling_corr(window=252, window_type=WindowType.expanding, method=CorrelationMethod.pearson)(x=d_rate, y=d_fx >> 30)

# ============================================================================
# REGIME CLASSIFICATION BY RATE DIFFERENTIAL QUARTILE
# ============================================================================
# Use expanding percentile rank to classify rate differential into quartiles

pct_rank = percentrank(period=252)(rate_diff)

# Monthly returns for USD/JPY
fx_ret = returns(type=ReturnsType.simple)(close_fx)

# Month number for grouping
month_num = datetime_extract(component='month')(ts)

# Regime labels: Narrow (Q1 ≤25%), Mid-Low (Q2 25-50%), Mid-High (Q3 50-75%), Wide (Q4 >75%)
regime_label = conditional_select(
    pct_rank <= 25, 'Q1: Narrow',
    pct_rank <= 50, 'Q2: Mid-Low',
    pct_rank <= 75, 'Q3: Mid-High',
    'Q4: Wide'
)

# ============================================================================
# REPORTER 1: Summary Statistics Table
# ============================================================================

summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Rate Differential & USD/JPY Key Metrics',
        row_size=2,
        col_size=3,
        row_headers=['Rate Differential (pp)', 'USD/JPY'],
        col_headers=['Current (Last)', 'Period Mean', 'Min / Max'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    ),
    category='1. Summary',
    order=0
)(rate_diff, rate_diff, rate_diff, close_fx, close_fx, close_fx)

# Correlation card
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Correlation Analysis',
        row_size=1,
        col_size=3,
        row_headers=['Pearson Correlation'],
        col_headers=['Full-Period (Levels)', 'Rolling 60d Mean', 'Rolling 60d Std'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Std, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3)
        ]
    ),
    category='1. Summary',
    order=1
)(full_corr, rolling_corr_60d, rolling_corr_60d)

# ============================================================================
# REPORTER 2: Dual-Axis Time Series — USD/JPY vs Rate Differential
# ============================================================================
# Two xy_lines in the same category to show both series on the time axis

xy_lines(
    title='USD/JPY Price (Left) vs US-Japan Rate Differential (Right)',
    category='2. Co-Movement',
    y_axis_label='USD/JPY',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='USD/JPY', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    order=0
)(x_values=ts, y_values=close_fx)

xy_lines(
    title='US-Japan 10Y Rate Differential (pp)',
    category='2. Co-Movement',
    y_axis_label='Rate Differential (pp)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Rate Differential', color=Color.Indigo, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, title='Zero', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    order=1
)(x_values=ts, y_values=rate_diff)

# ============================================================================
# REPORTER 3: Rolling 60-Day Correlation of Daily Changes
# ============================================================================

xy_lines(
    title='Rolling 60-Day Correlation: Daily Δ(Rate Diff) vs Daily Δ(USD/JPY)',
    category='3. Rolling Correlation',
    y_axis_label='Pearson Correlation',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Rolling 60d Corr', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, title='Zero', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    order=0
)(x_values=ts, y_values=rolling_corr_60d)

# ============================================================================
# REPORTER 4: Scatter — Rate Differential vs USD/JPY Level
# ============================================================================

xy_scatter(
    title='Rate Differential vs USD/JPY Level (Each Point = 1 Day)',
    category='4. Scatter & Regression',
    x_axis_label='US-Japan Rate Differential (pp)',
    y_axis_label='USD/JPY',
    x_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    x_axis_dp=2,
    series=ScatterSeriesSchema(series=[
        ScatterSeriesSpec(name='Daily Observations', color=Color.Blue, marker=MarkerSymbol.CircleMarker)
    ]),
    show_trend_line=True,
    order=0
)(x=rate_diff, y_values=close_fx)

# ============================================================================
# REPORTER 5: Lead/Lag Cross-Correlation
# ============================================================================
# Uses labeled_lines with x_labels as lag values and agg=Last for final
# expanding correlation at each lag offset.

labeled_lines(
    title='Lead/Lag Cross-Correlation (Daily Changes)',
    category='5. Lead-Lag Structure',
    x_axis_label='Lag (Days, Positive = Rate Diff Leads)',
    y_axis_label='Expanding Pearson Correlation',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=3,
    series=LabeledLineSeriesSchema(
        x_labels=['-30', '-20', '-10', '-5', '0', '+5', '+10', '+20', '+30'],
        series=[
            LineSeriesSpec(name='Cross-Correlation', color=Color.Blue, agg=AggregationType.Last, marker=MarkerSymbol.CircleMarker)
        ]
    ),
    y_reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, title='Zero', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    smooth=True,
    order=0
)(values=(corr_lag_n30, corr_lag_n20, corr_lag_n10, corr_lag_n5, corr_lag_0, corr_lag_p5, corr_lag_p10, corr_lag_p20, corr_lag_p30))

# ============================================================================
# REPORTER 6: Regime Breakdown — Avg Return by Rate Differential Quartile
# ============================================================================

xy_bars(
    title='Avg Daily USD/JPY Return by Rate Differential Regime',
    category='6. Regime Analysis',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    y_axis_label='Mean Daily Return',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=4,
    x_axis_label='Rate Differential Quartile',
    color_by_value=True,
    data_labels=True,
    order=0
)(values=fx_ret, label=regime_label)
